items.text_en: Surfaces and vessels that condense the high overnight dew of the lower ground.
items.text_hr: Površine i posude koje kondenziraju visoku noćnu rosu nižeg terena.

items.text_en: An earthen vessel that separates fresh water and salt using sun alone.
items.text_hr: Zemljana posuda koja samo suncem razdvaja slatku vodu i sol.

items.text_en: Pot in pot cooling, no electricity, for the hottest months.
items.text_hr: Hlađenje posudom u posudi, bez struje, za najtoplije mjesece.

items.text_en: Heat drawn from the compost pile for water and for the workshop.
items.text_hr: Toplina iz kompostišta za vodu i za radionicu.

items.text_en: No water, no septic tank, and soil at the end of it.
items.text_hr: Bez vode, bez septičke jame, a na kraju tlo.

items.text_en: Electricity generated for on-site needs only, sized to the work.
items.text_hr: Struja samo za potrebe terena, dimenzionirana prema poslu.
